data.one_liner: Dart FFI bindings to libserialport for accessing serial ports.
data.what_it_does: Provides Dart FFI bindings to the C library libserialport, enabling applications to list available serial ports, open them, read from and write to them.
use_when: You need to communicate with hardware devices over serial ports in a Dart or Flutter application.
You want stream-based reading capabilities from serial interfaces.
avoid_when: You are not prepared to bundle or deploy the native libserialport C library with your target application.
You only need high-level networking protocols instead of direct hardware serial communication.
strengths: Direct and efficient FFI bindings to libserialport.
Provides streams for easy asynchronous reading of incoming serial data.
weaknesses: Requires bundling native binaries on the target host platform.
Requires additional tooling or wrapper packages (like flutter_libserialport) for automated building and deployment on Flutter.
data.setup_notes: Requires libserialport to be bundled or deployed with the host application. For Flutter apps, using flutter_libserialport is recommended as a drop-in solution to handle native builds.
